name: NHDropshipping
author: nhdropshipping

sections.description:
NHDropshipping is a powerful WordPress plugin that seamlessly integrates your WooCommerce store with the NHDropshipping platform, enabling automated order fulfillment and inventory management.

Key Features:

  • Easy Store Connection: One-click connection to NHDropshipping platform
  • Automated Fulfillment: Streamlined order processing and shipping
  • Inventory Sync: Real-time inventory updates
  • Secure API Integration: Safe and secure connection using WooCommerce API keys
  • User-Friendly Interface: Clean and intuitive admin interface

Perfect for:
* E-commerce store owners looking for reliable dropshipping solutions
* Businesses wanting to expand their product catalog
* Entrepreneurs seeking automated fulfillment services

External Services

This plugin connects to external services provided by NHDropshipping to enable dropshipping functionality.

Service Details:
– Service: NHDropshipping API (https://dropshipping.nihaojewelry.com)
– Purpose: Store authentication, order processing, and inventory management
– Data Sent: Store URL, shop information, and order details when processing orders
– When Data is Sent: During store connection, order processing, and inventory synchronization
– Service Provider: NHDropshipping
– Terms of Service: https://www.nhdropshipping.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://www.nhdropshipping.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/nhdropshipping directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Navigate to the NHDropshipping settings page in your WordPress admin.
  5. Click “Get Started” to connect your store to NHDropshipping.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated. It integrates directly with WooCommerce’s API system.

Is my store data secure?

Yes, the plugin uses WooCommerce’s built-in API key system for secure authentication. All data transmission is encrypted and follows WordPress security best practices.

Can I disconnect my store from NHDropshipping?

Yes, you can disconnect your store at any time through the plugin settings page.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Deactivating the plugin will not affect your existing orders or products. However, new orders will not be automatically processed through NHDropshipping until you reactivate and reconnect the plugin.
